name: App Store Screenshot
description: Take a clean App Store screenshot with perfect status bar (9:41, full battery, full signal)

steps.script: do shell script "xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time '9:41' --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3"
steps.description: Override status bar to App Store standard (9:41, full battery/signal)

steps.script: do shell script "xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear"
steps.description: Clear status bar override back to normal

notes: Screenshot saves to ~/Desktop. For programmatic saving: xcrun simctl io booted screenshot /path/to/output.png
